feature_title: SLO Alert SLI Source Error Handling

rationale.edition: The two changed paths are web/src/views/slos/AddSlo.vue and web/src/views/slos/AddSloAlertSli.spec.ts, both under web/src (the OSS frontend). No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) are touched and there are no enterprise-gated keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) in the paths or symbols, so edition is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No tests-added label or skip comment was supplied (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty), and the change alters user-facing UI in web/src rather than being docs/CI/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff moves the alert SLI source load error off a sibling OBanner and onto the OSelect picker's own :error/:error-message props, and adds a guard so the empty-state banner is hidden while a load error is showing. A user can exercise this by opening Add SLO, choosing the alert SLI type, and triggering a source load failure.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/views/slos/AddSlo.vue (the Add SLO view). SLO is surfaced under the Alerts section of the OpenObserve UI, so the Alerts area is the closest existing playwright-tests folder for sibling specs.
rationale.group: The Alerts matrix shard is an existing ci-matrix group (the enterprise overlay appends alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js to it), so the new SLO alert-source spec belongs in the Alerts group.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/views/slos/AddSloAlertSli.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test under web/src — not a Playwright spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ — so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
